data.long_meaning: In Roman mythology, Estus was the god of fire. This name carries the strength and passion of the element it represents. The name Estus carries the meaning “God of Fire” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Estus usually hope their child will grow to embody god of fire and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Estus total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
